Release notes

The Gold Session Control update, followed by the 18 update groups from the v5.1.2 loader.

New: Gold Session Control
Your session. Your exit.
A gold crash button in Gameplay gives you a manual session-exit action. Loot preservation has been confirmed in player testing.
A shortcut of your own
Assign a single keyboard key to use with the menu closed. The shortcut starts Unbound, saves between sessions and can be cleared in the menu.
Gameplay and camera
Camera and lobby transitions
The camera scale runs from 60% to 200%. The override applies during gameplay, and camera settings save separately from presets.
Spin pause and resume
Pause and resume with a remappable key. The HUD shows OFF, PAUSED, WAITING, AIM or ON. Fresh gameplay sessions clear the previous pause state.
ESP, reticles and layout
ESP range and distance fading
Set the range up to 2,500 m. Overlays stay fully opaque within the nearest 20% of that range and fade to 40% opacity farther away.
Category colour controls
Players, Team, Bots, World and Equipment each get a visible and invisible colour. Element switches remain available, and health stays green.
PNG devil crosshair
The transparent Devil face artwork has cleaner edges above the horns and keeps its centre dot.
Reticle styles and RGB
Choose Precision, Heart, Quackshot, Alpha-Q logo, Devil face or Pentagram. The HUD includes a live preview and saves RGB cycle speed separately.
Menu and balanced HUD
Six tabs, stronger contrast and a collapsible preset sidebar. The HUD groups reticle controls and preview above awareness and tracers.
Aim and targeting
Aim acquisition
The target search covers more eligible targets. The configured bone comes first, with additional points available when Bone scan is enabled.
Shot response and revalidation
Normal auto-fire waits for aim alignment. The selected target and shot conditions are checked again before firing.
Prediction and target state
Moving-target prediction checks that its solution is still valid. Changes in session or aim state clear stale targets.
Shield bone preference
Choose Off, Probing or Prefer ankles. Probing follows a timer based on automatic-fire requests.
Bot targeting control
Bot targeting starts off. Its toggle works with master aim and the configured activation key.
Presets and shortcuts
Remappable feature shortcuts
Bot targeting and spin pause default to B and T. Rebind them in the menu. Input guards cover typing, focus changes and shortcut capture.
Preset library and recovery
Load, save, create, rename and duplicate presets. A checkmark identifies the active preset, and recovery copies protect overwritten or deleted presets.
Preset hotkeys
Switch with the menu open or closed. Bindings follow renamed presets, and existing Num 1–4 assignments are supported.
Loader and activation
Confirmed loader completion
The loader waits up to 60 seconds for the menu to report readiness, then closes after cleanup. Failures remain visible in its status and log.
Loader, updates and community
The AQx loader shows the cumulative updates in a scrollable panel and includes links to the community.
Online activation
Online verification checks access and expiry before launch. A remembered key is protected for the Windows account.

Choose your access.

Windows compatibility
AQx v5.1.2 does not work on Windows 11 version 25H2 or later.

Before
you start.

How do I use Gold Session Control?+

In a match, open Gameplay and find Session Control. Click the gold crash button to trigger the manual session-exit action. Loot preservation has been confirmed in player testing; ask the Discord team for the current supported build and its requirements.

Can I give Session Control its own shortcut?+

Yes. It starts Unbound. Click the shortcut control, release held keys and press your chosen keyboard key. Your assignment saves between sessions and works with the menu closed. Escape cancels assignment; Backspace or Clear removes it. Keys already used by features or presets cannot be assigned.

Does Session Control protect my loot automatically?+

You choose when to activate it. Loot retention depends on the game and session behaviour. It does not automatically activate when you are downed or recover loot already lost.

How do I get my key and build?+

Join the Discord and ask the team about your chosen duration. Your key and build are delivered manually through Discord. This page does not process payments or issue licenses.

When does my access period begin?+

Timed keys start counting on first activation and last 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days or 30 days. Lifetime keys have no expiry. Ask the team which build and activation requirements apply before purchasing.

Can I switch presets with the menu closed?+

Yes. Preset hotkeys work with the menu open or closed. Activation pauses during text entry, widget interactions and key capture. Release held keys after these interactions before switching again.

What can I use for a custom bind?+

A single keyboard key or one of the five physical mouse buttons. Preset bindings are saved between sessions. Multi-key chords and mouse wheel movements are not supported by the preset binding system. Existing feature shortcuts retain their actions.

Where do these screenshots come from?+

The Session Control showcase and Gameplay gallery use the Gold Session Control menu preview with the preset sidebar visible. The other five tabs come from the v5.1.2 gameplay lifecycle baseline. The loader image comes from the v5.1.2 UI fixture. These are rendered interface previews.
